name: audio_tts
description: TTS voiceover. ElevenLabs/Google: voiceId (single) or speakers (2) — get via `audio_voices_show` (or `audio_voices_list` without UI). Seed Audio (model=seed_audio_1_0): voice-less, no voiceId, maxDuration required. Call `audio_tts_direction` (with `model` if you set one) before writing `text`: each model reads tags, pauses and scene scripts differently.

audioUrls.description: seed_audio_1_0 only; <=3 reference audios for voice style: a creation identifier or a Magnific asset URL. External/local file: import it with `creations_request_upload` + `creations_finalize_upload` first.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

imageUrl.description: seed_audio_1_0 only; style reference: a creation identifier or a Magnific asset URL (import an external image with `creations_upload_image`); excludes audioUrls.

model.description: Default: eleven_v4 where available and the text fits its 10k cap, else eleven_v3, or gemini_v2_5_pro. Authorized BYOK slugs: audio_voices_list models; use a voice with the same provider, single speaker.

source.description: mine=cloned My Voice; catalog=shared. Required when the same id exists in both.
Same as top-level source, per speaker.

text.description: Max 40k (seed_audio_1_0: 2k; eleven_v4/eleven_v4_turbo: 10k; free plan: 500). Eleven v3 best <=3k; turbo <=10k.

voiceId.description: From audio_voices_list, or a past voiceover's metadata.voice_info.id (creations_get). Cloned rows need source=mine (ids overlap the catalog). Required unless speakers or model=seed_audio_1_0.
